comment: Dragon Tempest, both clauses, on a board where each is separately visible. Lathliss (a 6/6 flier) is the only Dragon, so the ETB ping is X=1 -> 20 to 19; she then attacks for 6 -> 13. The attack is the HASTE clause: she entered this turn, so without Dragon Tempest's 'whenever a creature you control with flying enters, it gains haste' she is summoning-sick and deals nothing. A win-turn assertion cannot see either half (neither is lethal here), which is why this pins opponent_life exactly: 13 fails if the ping deals the wrong X OR if the haste grant stops firing.
